title: Helsinki demonstration against COVID-19 gathering restrictions at Kansalaistori
organizer: not identified in the accessed report
participants_original: Police and a Lehtikuva photographer estimated about 50 participants. After a dispersal order, about ten remained. The estimate is approximate and at the threshold.
threshold_50_evidence: STT report relays police and Lehtikuva photographer estimate of about 50 at the gathering; an approximate single-source estimate exactly at threshold.

start_date.summary: STT report published 12 December 2020 at 17:45 says police intervened that afternoon.

end_date.summary: Police order dispersed most of the group; about ten remained and the demonstration ended.

demands.summary: Demonstrators opposed gathering restrictions imposed in response to coronavirus; these were domestic public-event restrictions.

participants.summary: Police and Lehtikuva photographer estimate about 50; about ten remained after the dispersal order. Approximate count retained as reported.

threshold_50.summary: The one accessed STT report says police and a Lehtikuva photographer estimated about 50 at the protest. Borderline and not independently corroborated.

state_target.summary: The demonstration protested domestic public-assembly restrictions; Helsinki police enforced a Southern Finland AVI cap on public events/meetings.

state_response.summary: Police issued a dispersal order; the gathering ended after most participants left.

notes: Single report with approximate turnout exactly at minimum. Not accepted; reviewer should assess threshold. Do not merge with planned Dec 31 listing or other anti-restriction actions.
